name: Onier
source:
Onier (full name is Onier Anarai) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
Onier is an adult golden-eye gold om'verai with a beck-like face. Her front side is covered with red plates. Back side of a neck is covered by a fin, Onyr has whiskers on cheeks and 2 long head horns.
"Personality: Error 404. File is not found" - Azaries' diary.

Onier is a wise om'verai with a large amount of knowledge in her head, thanks to her job of a Keeper of Knowledge. On other hand, Onyr is hard to understand and to speak with.
